notes.title: Rat Quest V1.2 (and V1.1)
notes.content:
1.1
Limited Fps to 120

V1.2

Adjusted Fire Hitbox

Fixed a bug that let you be financially irresponsible by going into cheese debt.

Fixed Bug that caused dev log not to appear.

Added secrets no one will find. (Hint: versions and logos)


(p.s, it should be fine but there's a slight chance i accidently removed all your save data, if you were effected, please let me know in the reply's and ill find a way to fix it.

notes.title: Rat Quest Is Now Updated!!!
notes.content:
After almost a year, rat quest is finally updated!!!

New Things


 Shop - buy upgrades to make rat quest easier
 Secrets  - what's rat quest without it's secrets
 Exciting Gameplay - I've added new things to keep Rat Quest fun since the play time is much longer now!
 C H E E S E - self explanatory 
 partial controller support
 more levels
 and more!!!!


But I'm not done yet, i still have more to add!

Full Controller Support

its not in yet because it could take a few more months and i didn't want to delay over that, so ill add it at a later date!

Achievements

This was a requested feature that i intended to add but I'm not good with all the steam stuff, so i didn't want to delay over this either.

Community items

This one is a tough one, i don't currently qualify and I'm not sure when (or if) i will, ill add them as soon as I can though.

That being said, Have fun!!!!
